title: Ye absolute glaikit numpty
description: Translation: You utterly foolish idiot | Provenance: Pan-Scots; glaikit = scatterbrained; numpty = modern urban slang (Glasgow)

title: Yer heid’s full o mince
description: Translation: Your head is full of nonsense | Provenance: Common Central Belt idiom; 20th–21st c

title: Ye couldnae mind yer ain shaddin
description: Translation: You couldn’t mind your own shadow | Provenance: Rural and old-fashioned Lowland expression

title: Ye’re as useful as a chocolate fireguard
description: Translation: You are completely useless | Provenance: UK-wide but common in Scots humour

title: Yer brain’s awa for a daunder
description: Translation: Your brain has gone for a wander | Provenance: Daunder is Scots for stroll; modern urban speech

title: Ye’ve the sense o a stunned haddie
description: Translation: You have the sense of a stunned haddock | Provenance: North-East and coastal Scots; haddie = haddock

title: Ye’re a richt haverel
description: Translation: You’re a real fool | Provenance: Haverel is older Scots; in use since 18th–19th c

title: Yer face is trippin ye
description: Translation: You look utterly miserable or annoyed | Provenance: Central Belt idiom; common 20th–21st c

title: Ye’re as sharp as a soup plate

title: Yer heid’s full o buttons
description: Translation: Your head is full of nonsense | Provenance: Lowland Scots; older domestic imagery

title: Ye couldnae run a minodge

title: Yer patter’s as thin as broth

title: Yer lights are on but naebody’s hame

title: Ye’re a fly wee nyaff
description: Translation: You’re a sly little nuisance | Provenance: Nyaff (Glasgow); fly = sly

title: Yer brain’s takin a day aff
description: Translation: Your brain is taking the day off | Provenance: Contemporary humour

title: Ye’re a bletherin eejit

title: Yer smirk wid sour milk
description: Translation: Your smirk is intensely irritating | Provenance: Domestic imagery; Central Belt

description: Translation: You give me a sore head just looking at you | Provenance: Common teasing insult
